What is the FIRST step in the CompTIA troubleshooting methodology?
Establish a theory of probable cause
Which action is part of identifying the problem?
Gathering information from the user and the system
Which question helps identify the problem when a user reports an issue?
What exactly is not working, and when did it start?
Why should you ask whether anything changed recently when identifying a problem?
Recent changes are a common cause of new issues
Which practice helps identify a problem accurately?
A user says 'the internet is down.' What should you do to identify the problem?
Ask clarifying questions to determine the exact symptom and scope
Which information source helps determine the scope of a problem?
Checking whether other users or devices are affected
Which step helps identify the problem by reviewing recent events?
Checking change logs and recent configuration changes
Which approach helps when multiple symptoms are reported?
Determining whether they share a common cause or are separate issues
Treating them all as one without analysis
Why is it important to gather information from the affected user?
Users can describe what they experienced and when
Which practice helps avoid misidentifying a problem?
Not assuming the cause before gathering facts
Which detail is useful when identifying a connectivity problem?
Whether the issue is intermittent or constant
Which tool output helps identify a problem's symptoms?
Which step is part of identifying the problem in a methodical way?
Which practice helps identify whether a problem is local or network-wide?
Testing connectivity from multiple devices and locations
A problem started right after a software update. What does this suggest during identification?
The update may be related to the problem
Which step helps define a problem's boundaries?
Determining what works and what doesn't
Which practice supports accurate problem identification?
Documenting symptoms as you gather them
Which is a good question to determine impact during identification?
How many users or systems are affected?
Which practice helps identify environmental causes?
Checking for recent physical, power, or environmental changes
Which action helps identify a problem that only some users experience?
Comparing affected and unaffected users for differences
Which practice avoids wasting time during identification?
Focusing on relevant information and symptoms
A user reports slow performance only in the afternoon. What should identification capture?
The time pattern and possible related activity
Which step confirms you understand the problem before proceeding?
Restating the problem clearly based on gathered information
Which practice helps identify problems in a complex environment?
Dividing the system into parts to isolate the issue
Treating it as one black box
Which is part of gathering information during identification?
Reviewing recent tickets or similar past incidents
Which detail helps identify a wireless problem specifically?
Whether the issue affects only wireless clients
Which practice helps when a user's description is unclear?
Asking follow-up questions and observing the issue directly
Which step helps identify whether a problem is reproducible?
Attempting to recreate the reported behavior
Which practice supports identifying intermittent problems?
Collecting information about when and how often it occurs
Which is the goal of the identify-the-problem step?
To clearly understand the symptoms, scope, and possible triggers
Which practice helps avoid solving the wrong problem?
Confirming the actual symptom rather than assuming
Which information helps prioritize a problem during identification?
The severity and number of affected users
Which step helps identify a problem caused by a specific application?
Determining whether only that application is affected
Which practice helps gather accurate symptom details?
Having the user demonstrate the issue when possible
Which action is NOT part of identifying the problem?
Which practice helps identify problems that appear after maintenance?
Reviewing what maintenance was performed and when
Which detail helps identify a DNS-related symptom?
Whether sites work by IP but not by name
Which practice helps identify the scope of an outage?
Checking whether it affects one site, a VLAN, or the whole network
Which is the benefit of thorough problem identification?
It leads to more accurate theories and faster resolution
Which practice helps identify a problem without bias?
Considering multiple possible symptoms before narrowing down
Which question helps identify recent user actions related to a problem?
What were you doing when the issue started?
Which practice helps identify a hardware versus software problem?
Observing whether the issue follows the device or the software
Which step helps identify a problem affecting only remote users?
Determining whether on-site users are also affected
Which practice supports identifying problems in a shared environment?
Checking whether the issue correlates with specific times or loads
Which action helps confirm the reported problem is current?
Verifying the issue still occurs at the time of troubleshooting
Which detail is relevant when identifying a printing problem?
Whether all users or only one cannot print
Which practice helps avoid overlooking a simple cause during identification?
Checking basics like cables, power, and connections
Which practice helps identify a problem introduced by a configuration change?
Comparing the current configuration to a known-good baseline
Which BEST summarizes the identify-the-problem step?
Gather information, identify symptoms, determine scope, and question users to understand the issue
